name: Zero Gate of the Void
desc: Skip your next Draw Phase. When an opponent's monster with ATK greater than or equal to your LP declares a direct attack and you have no cards in your hand: You can banish this card from your GY; negate the attack, and if you do, Special Summon 1 "Void Ogre Dragon" monster from your Extra Deck (this is treated as a Synchro Summon). While it is face-up in the Monster Zone, you take no damage. When it leaves the field, take 4000 damage.
